$comment: SLOP-3: starting a BLOCKED issue asks Cancel / Start anyway / Stacked PR, byte-identical x4 (web lib/blocked-start.ts, desktop domain blocked_start.rs, iOS BlockedStart.swift, Android BlockedStart.kt). The stacked start is PROMPT TEXT only: the same base instruction a follow-up run gets from the playbook. No stack plan, no relay frame, no server code. `stackTarget` picks the one blocker to stack on or the one reason the button is disabled (first match wins, in the order of `reasons`).

copy.title: This issue is blocked
copy.batchTitle: Some of these issues are blocked
copy.batchBody: Open issues outside this batch block it. Start anyway?
copy.bodySuffixStackable: . Start anyway, or start a stacked PR?

notes.batch: A stacked PR starts one issue at a time.
notes.many: A stacked PR needs exactly one open blocker.
notes.no-pr: #{ident} has no open pull request yet.

promptTemplate: Stacked on #{ident}. Before any edit: `git fetch origin {branch}`; if this branch has no commits of its own, `git reset --hard origin/{branch}`, else `git rebase origin/{branch}`. Open your PR with `exponential_pr_open({issueId, base: "{branch}"})`.
